draft.subject: One quick step to get Lantern Ventures moving
draft.body:
Hi Wei,

I know a few notes from us have landed in your inbox already, so I'll keep this one short.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so creating a first project is usually the step that makes everything else fall into place. If it's useful, the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. When you're ready for your team, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? Happy to work through that first project with you.

Best,
Chidi
